message.content:
Now I need to understand how uninitialized coefficients can occur. The crash is a Use-of-uninitialized-value in `encode_one_block`. This happens when the source JPEG has incomplete scan data - some DCT blocks are never filled in because the scan data is truncated or the image dimensions don't match the actual data.

Let me look at how the decompressor handles incomplete data. The key is in `jdcoefct.c` - when the input is exhausted before all coefficients are read, some blocks may remain uninitialized. Let me look at the `consume_data` function:
